items.note: The single conflated `variant` input split into two orthogonal axes: `color` (primary|secondary|tertiary|neutral|error|success|warning, default primary) x `variant` (solid|tonal|ghost|outline|text, default solid). Static values migrate per the map. DYNAMIC `[variant]="expr"` bindings whose expression yields only hue values (primary/error/success/warning) rebind to `[color]="expr"` verbatim; expressions/fields typed with a mixed-axis union must be retyped to the new fill vocabulary and split per axis. `variant="text"` stays valid (its map entry is an identity — same token in, same out — so the applier leaves it untouched); it is discouraged at runtime (dev-mode console.warn — prefer the global `.link` class) but requires no code migration.

ButtonSize collapsed to sm|md|lg (32/40/48px); the duplicate legacy one-letter tier is dropped. sm/md/lg values are unchanged (absent from the map — leave them). Default is now md (was l — same 40px, no action for attribute-less buttons). The 24px `s` is removed — its callers move to sm (32px, the closest). The exported TS type `ButtonSize` narrowed in lockstep from the old `s|m|l|sm|md|lg` superset to `sm|md|lg`: a consumer who typed a field/variable/input with `ButtonSize` and assigned a legacy literal (`'s'`/`'m'`/`'l'`) now gets a compile error — remap those literals the same way (`s`/`m`->`sm`, `l`->`md`).

The exported ButtonVariant union changed to the fill vocabulary (solid|tonal|ghost|outline|text); hue values moved to the NEW exported ButtonColor (primary|secondary|tertiary|neutral|error|success|warning). Consumer TS importing ButtonVariant, or typing its own fields/inputs with the old values: a purely-hue union retypes to ButtonColor (and its bindings move to [color]); a purely-fill union remaps values (secondary->tonal, tertiary->ghost, outline stays outline); a mixed-axis union must be split per axis.

Reactive-forms radio now uses the new <ds-radio-group> as the group container and form control (ControlValueAccessor, roving tabindex, name, group label/invalid/hint). A group of <ds-radio value> bound into a reactive form (formControlName/[formControl]/[(ngModel)] on the group) must be wrapped in <ds-radio-group>. Standalone <ds-radio [(checked)]> is unaffected.
Field helper/error text is now rendered by the shared ds-field-message; the new hook applies to EVERY field's helper/error line, not just input.

ds-bottom-sheet now animates its close; the (closed) output emits at the END of the leave animation instead of on the click. Review (closed) handlers that assumed synchronous-on-click ordering (immediate re-open, focus timing); usually no change is needed.

The old faint pressed halo now defaults to `none` (press feedback became darken + micro scale-down). Only consumers who RELIED on the halo act: set --ds-button-pressed-shadow explicitly to re-enable. No usage -> no action.

Default DISABLED appearance changed: `[disabled]` is now a per-variant muted tint derived from each variant's own colour (solid + text use a flat pale oklch tint; tonal/ghost/outline and icon-button tonal/outlined use color-mix with --surface-disabled), not one flat grey. Visual-only, no API change. To restore the old flat grey, override the per-variant `--ds-button-*-disabled` / `--ds-icon-button-*-disabled` tokens. Most consumers take no action — eyeball the disabled states.

ds-modal and ds-drawer now animate their close (animate-then-remove, like ds-bottom-sheet) instead of vanishing instantly; honors prefers-reduced-motion. Any close-related output/teardown fires at the END of the leave animation, not synchronously on the dismiss click — review handlers that assumed synchronous-on-click ordering (immediate re-open, focus hand-off). Usually no change needed.

Only consumers who import `styles/tokens` A LA CARTE (not via the `styles/ds` entry, which forwards both): the `--bp-*` custom properties moved into the new `styles/breakpoints` partial, so an a-la-carte tokens importer must now also `@use` styles/breakpoints to keep `--bp-*` defined. Consumers using `styles/ds` need no action.

informational: Many new components (multi-select, slider, otp-input, color-picker, tree, segmented, button-group, split-button, toggle-button, list, timeline, description-list, stack/inline/container, loading-overlay, radio-group, alert) — additive.

ds-color scoped-accent system (--accent-* pointer layer, [ds-color] attribute, ds.color() mixin) + dark theme (opt-in via data-theme=dark, provideDsTheme({followSystem})) — additive, light output unchanged.

Reactive-forms (CVA) + invalid/hint on checkbox, switch, combobox, date-picker; hint/invalid on select; inline [label] on checkbox/radio/switch; input [loading]/[floating]; --field-label-gap — additive.

ds-button overlay-trigger inputs (ariaHasPopup/ariaExpanded/buttonRef); date-picker month/year grid pickers; table pagination/clientSort/stickyFirstColumn; ModalService.confirm(); dropzone per-file message + queued state — additive.
$bp-* Sass breakpoint aliases + up()/down() mixins; new disabled-state and press-scale override tokens — additive (a-la-carte styles/tokens importers also need styles/breakpoints now).

Visual-only: button/icon-button press is darken + micro scale-down; [disabled] is a per-variant muted tint (override --ds-*-disabled tokens to restore flat grey); smooth motion pass across components; reduced-motion no longer freezes spinners; overlay scroll-lock release fix.
